flashcards.q: How is windows used in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Describe how a large language model produces text, including tokens, training, context windows and temperature.

flashcards.q: How should never not be handled in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It never plans the whole answer in advance the way a person outlines an essay; the structure you see emerges from predicting well, one step at a time.

flashcards.q: What does AI Foundations For Business teach about main risks?
flashcards.a: You will learn to break a business process into task types, estimate what an AI feature will cost, test a tool before trusting it, and manage the main risks.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with answers in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It gives you a working understanding of what artificial intelligence is, how the language models behind today's AI assistants actually produce their answers, and how to decide where AI belongs in a business and where it does not.

flashcards.q: When is grounding applied in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Explain grounding and retrieval, and when a deterministic answer beats a generated one.

flashcards.q: When should came not be used in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: For most of the decades since, progress came in waves, with periods of excitement followed by periods when funding and interest dropped because the systems could not live up to their promises.

flashcards.q: Where does king Academy come up in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: The chapter closes with a field case from the Sales King Academy platform itself and a lab you complete on the live site, so every idea is tied to a real system you can see and use.

flashcards.q: Where does million parameters not apply in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: **No room for an in-house model.** The platform has its own small language model, called ska_own, with about 2.7 million parameters, six layers and a 128-token context window, small enough to fit in about 2.7 megabytes.

flashcards.q: Is decide whether always required in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: For each question type below, decide whether the answer should be deterministic, grounded generation, or open generation.

flashcards.q: Is false statement ever unnecessary in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: | Tool | Total score | Answers with a false statement | Cost per 1,000 answers (example figures) | |---|---|---|---| | A (large model, no grounding) | 251 / 320 | 6 | $9.00 | | B (smaller model, grounded in the lease and policy documents) | 284 / 320 | 1 | $2.40 |

flashcards.q: Which approach to seems fits AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: The number seems off," which contains none of the keywords.

flashcards.q: Which uses of spam filter should be ruled out in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: A spam filter trained on millions of labelled emails learns which features tend to appear in spam, without anyone writing a rule for each one.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with emails in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: A small accounting firm receives about 400 client emails a week.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling your in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It is not a mind that understands your business the way an experienced employee does.

flashcards.q: Why does false things matter in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Explain why language models sometimes state false things with confidence, and name the practical controls that reduce it.

flashcards.q: How is exact used in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Most good business systems combine both: rules for the decisions that must be exact and auditable, learned models for the steps that require reading or judgment.

flashcards.q: How should remove not be handled in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Remove steps that add no value, then decide which remaining steps AI should assist and which should stay with people.

flashcards.q: What does AI Foundations For Business teach about plain language?
flashcards.a: Explain in plain language what artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative AI are, and how they differ.

flashcards.q: What should be avoided with easy in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It is predictable and easy to audit, but it cannot handle situations its author did not anticipate.

flashcards.q: When is provider charges applied in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: First, almost every AI provider charges by the token, usually with separate prices for the tokens you send in (input) and the tokens the model writes (output).

flashcards.q: When should nobody not be used in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It handles vague emails well, but on the rare occasion it misreads a message, nobody notices until a client complains.

flashcards.q: Where does dartmouth College come up in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: The term was coined in the 1955 proposal for a 1956 summer workshop at Dartmouth College, where a small group of researchers set out to study how machines could use language, form concepts and solve problems.

flashcards.q: Where does cloudflare not apply in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Every generated word in a chat reply therefore comes from open models that Cloudflare hosts and bills per use, not from the platform's own model.

flashcards.q: Is false output always required in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: **False output.** Covered above: the model states something untrue.

flashcards.q: Is tell ever unnecessary in AI Foundations For Business?
Which approach to picks fits AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: At a low temperature the model almost always picks the most likely token, which makes answers consistent and predictable.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with office manager in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: The owner wants each email routed to the right person: billing questions to the office manager, tax questions to the senior accountant, and document uploads to a shared folder.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling nobody in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: It handles vague emails well, but on the rare occasion it misreads a message, nobody notices until a client complains.

flashcards.q: Why does tokens matter in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: Tokens matter to a business for two reasons.

flashcards.q: How is invoice used in AI Foundations For Business?
flashcards.a: A purely rule-based approach would search for keywords such as "invoice" or "W-2".
